battle.label: battle
battle.desc: part of a war which is well defined in duration, area and force commitment

siege.label: siege
siege.desc: military blockade of a city or fortress

war.label: war
war.desc: organized and prolonged violent conflict between different nations, states, or different groups within a nation or state

massacre.label: massacre
massacre.desc: incident where some group is killed by another

coup.label: coup d'état
coup.desc: act in which a segment of the military or government elites uses force to illegally and overtly overthrow an incumbent government in an attempt to seize state power

riot.label: riot
riot.desc: violent public disturbance against authority, property or people

fortif.label: fortification
fortif.desc: military constructions and buildings designed for defense in warfare and military bases

milbase.label: military base
milbase.desc: facility directly owned and operated by or for the military

treaty.label: treaty
treaty.desc: express agreement between nations under international law

parliament.label: parliament building
parliament.desc: subclass of a legislative building, used by countries/entities which have a parliamentary form of government

capital.label: capital city
capital.desc: primary governing city of a top-level (country) or first-level and second-level subdivision (country, state, province, regency, etc) political entity

courthouse.label: courthouse
courthouse.desc: building which is home to a court

embassy.label: embassy
embassy.desc: permanent diplomatic mission of higher level, representing its operator in the country the embassy is in

earthquake.label: earthquake
earthquake.desc: result of a sudden release of energy in the Earth's crust that creates seismic waves

eruption.label: volcanic eruption
eruption.desc: natural phenomenon where lava, hot gases or other substances are emitted suddenly from a geological feature

shipwreck.label: shipwreck
shipwreck.desc: remains of a ship that has wrecked

flood.label: flood
flood.desc: overflow of water that submerges land that is usually dry

fire.label: conflagration
fire.desc: large and destructive fire that threatens human life, animal life, health, and/or property

aircrash.label: aviation accident
aircrash.desc: aviation occurrence involving serious injury, death, or destruction of aircraft

railcrash.label: railway accident
railcrash.desc: disaster involving one or more trains (for train colliding with a pedestrian, animal or other objects, see Q19403959; for two trains, see Q11396408)

archaeology.label: archaeological site
archaeology.desc: place (or group of physical sites) in which evidence of past activity is preserved

town.label: town
town.desc: settlement that is smaller than a city but bigger than a large village (or a large borough in some areas)

village.label: village
village.desc: small clustered human settlement smaller than a town

ghosttown.label: ghost town
ghosttown.desc: city depopulated of inhabitants and that often stays practically intact

mine.label: mine
mine.desc: place for the extraction of minerals

prison.label: prison
prison.desc: place in which people are, for legal reasons, physically confined and usually deprived of a range of personal freedoms

castle.label: castle
castle.desc: type of fortified structure built in Europe, Asia and the Middle East during the Middle Ages by nobility

cathedral.label: cathedral
cathedral.desc: Christian church, which is seat of a bishop

mosque.label: mosque
mosque.desc: place of worship for followers of Islam

synagogue.label: synagogue
synagogue.desc: religious building at the center of a local organization where a Jewish (or rarely Samaritan) community gathers for prayer, education, social assistance or ceremonies

temple.label: temple
temple.desc: structure reserved for religious or spiritual activities

monastery.label: monastery
monastery.desc: complex of buildings comprising the domestic quarters and workplace(s) of monks or nuns

palace.label: palace
palace.desc: grand residence, especially a royal or episcopal residence

heritage.label: World Heritage Site
heritage.desc: place of significance listed by UNESCO

monument.label: monument
monument.desc: imposing structure created to commemorate a person or event, or used for that purpose

lighthouse.label: lighthouse
lighthouse.desc: structure designed to emit light to aid navigation

bridge.label: bridge
bridge.desc: structure that spans and provides a passage over a road, railway, river, or some other obstacle

dam.label: dam
dam.desc: barrier that impounds water or underground streams

railstation.label: railway station
railstation.desc: railway facility where trains regularly stop to load or unload passengers and/or freight

airport.label: airport
airport.desc: location where aircraft take off and land with extended support facilities, mostly for commercial air transport

stadium.label: stadium
stadium.desc: place or venue for (mostly) outdoor sports, concerts, or other events

factory.label: factory
factory.desc: facility where goods are industrially made, or processed

university.label: university
university.desc: an institution of tertiary education and research which awards academic degrees in several academic disciplines

school.label: school
school.desc: institution for the education of students by teachers

observatory.label: astronomical observatory
observatory.desc: location used for observing celestial events

museum.label: museum
museum.desc: institution that holds artifacts and other objects of scientific, artistic, cultural, historical, or other importance

library.label: library
library.desc: institution charged with the care of a collection of literary, musical, artistic, or reference materials, such as books, manuscripts, recordings, or films

operahouse.label: opera house
operahouse.desc: theatre building used for opera performances

botanic.label: botanical garden
botanic.desc: area displaying a wide range of plants labelled with their botanical names

zoo.label: zoo
zoo.desc: collection of assorted wild animal species kept for purposes like: study, conservation and, or, commercial exhibition

expedition.label: expedition
expedition.desc: discovery or research trip to a remote or undeveloped region

spaceport.label: spaceport
spaceport.desc: location used to launch and receive spacecraft
